subject: Vendor registration + PO capture / invoice acceptance rules for AlderTech
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@aldertech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: AlderTech AP <ap@aldertech.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Sep 2025 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Vendor registration & PO capture requirements for AlderTech

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Thanks for taking this — AlderTech is ready to register Redwood as a vendor in our AP system so we can start routing POs and paying pilot invoices. Attached is our PO template (AlderTech_PO_Template.xlsx) and a short vendor enrollment form we use. Before we kick off, quick clarifying questions so our onboarding team can provision correctly:

- Do your invoices require the AlderTech PO number to be in the invoice header, or is an invoice body reference sufficient?
- If a PO is issued after an invoice (stub/retro PO), will your team accept a "Pending PO" status and reissue or amend if requested?
- For EU VAT handling: do you invoice with a VAT number on file, or do you provide a VAT self-cert / exemption document?

We usually ask vendors to fill our enrollment form and upload any tax certificates. Our AP inbox is ap@aldertech.com if you want to route the docs directly.

Appreciate a quick reply — we aim to have you registered by the end of next week if everything is in order.

Best,
Sophie Grant
Vendor Ops | AlderTech
Sophie.Grant@aldertech.com

Attachment: AlderTech_PO_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie.grant@aldertech.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Sep 2025 10:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO capture requirements for AlderTech

Thanks Sophie — happy to get this moving. Quick answers and a proposed on-ramp so the pilot billing isn't blocked: 

1) PO placement: preferred = PO number in the invoice header (Invoice top-right, labeled "Customer PO"). Fallback = invoice body reference is acceptable for the pilot, but must include exact PO string.

2) Stub/retro PO flow: we can support a "PO-STUB" workflow where invoices are submitted with a PO-STUB-<clientid>-YYMMDD reference if the formal PO isn't in your system yet. Redwood will update the invoice with the official PO within 30 days after it's issued. Please confirm if AlderTech will accept "Pending PO" as an intermediate status rather than rejecting for missing PO.

3) VAT: for EU customers that claim exemption/reverse-charge, we provide a VAT self-certification document (attached: Redwood_VAT_Self-Certification.pdf) and include our VAT ID on all invoices. If AlderTech requires a specific form, we can sign and return it.

Payment terms and cutoffs (proposed for pilot):
- Standard: Net 30 after invoice approval.
- Pilot ask: Net 21 (to help cash flow).
- Cutoff for running month: invoices submitted by the 20th get processed in the month; invoices after 20th roll to next cycle.
- Early-pay: we can offer 1% discount if paid within 14 days.

Acceptance SLA: we ask for 5 business days for PO matching and dispute flagging; after that the invoice moves to payment queue once matched. If you prefer shorter SLA we can negotiate.

Next steps (mutual action plan):
- We submit vendor enrollment + VAT self-cert to ap@aldertech.com (Marcus) — today
- AlderTech registers vendor and returns vendor ID (Sophie) — target +3 business days
- We send first pilot invoice with PO-STUB prefix if PO pending (Naomi) — within 7 days of registration

If that works, let's confirm a 30-min call to finalize the small details (bank remit format, currency mapping, and PO lifecycle).

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_VAT_Self-Certification.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)

On Tue, 09 Sep 2025 at 10:05, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> 2) Stub/retro PO flow: we can support a "PO-STUB" workflow...

Thanks Marcus — that approach should be fine for the pilot. A few clarifications from our side:

- AlderTech will accept invoices with a "Pending PO" status for up to 30 days. After 30 days, invoices must be amended with the official PO or they move to review.
- Please include your VAT number on the invoice and attach the VAT self-cert to the enrollment packet.
- Our vendor form must be completed and signed — we prefer DocuSign for the audit trail. I'll send the DocuSign link once I confirm the vendor legal name and bank remit details.

I'll loop in our AP inbox to watch for your submission: ap@aldertech.com. I'll also attach our PO template again for the formatting fields we prefer.

Sophie
Vendor Ops | AlderTech
